verdict.rationale: Supermemory ships an official MCP server described as giving 'every MCP-compatible assistant a shared memory layer,' which can be used through natural-language requests and scoped by spaces. A community report independently notes the Supermemory MCP reached 60k+ daily users, which supports real cross-assistant adoption. Missing for 10: no evidence names setup flows for Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor specifically, and no hands-on proof that memory written in one assistant is recalled in another.
